#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only, conservative configuration inventory; not a safety certification."""
import argparse
from collections import Counter
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys


PILLARS = [
    (0, "steering", "Steering docs"),
    (0, "gates", "Validation gates"),
    (0, "commits", "Commit conventions"),
    (0, "hooks", "Hooks, not rules"),
    (0, "permissions", "Permissions & blast radius"),
    (1, "ci", "CI/CD pipeline"),
    (1, "trunk", "Trunk-based development"),
    (1, "skills", "Skills"),
    (1, "cleancode", "Clean code & comments"),
    (1, "testint", "Test integrity"),
    (1, "arch", "Architecture as a gate"),
    (1, "devcontainer", "Devcontainer"),
    (2, "adrs", "Lean docs & ADRs"),
    (2, "sessions", "Sessions & handoffs"),
    (2, "graph", "Code graph"),
    (2, "vdocs", "Versioned docs"),
    (2, "memory", "Memory bank"),
    (2, "supply", "Supply chain & untrusted input"),
    (2, "where", "Where does this fact live?"),
    (3, "agents", "Agents & orchestration"),
    (3, "bots", "PR review & autonomy"),
    (3, "tracker", "Issues to roadmap"),
    (3, "deploy", "Deploy & kill switches"),
    (3, "metrics", "Metrics & evals"),
    (3, "meta", "Meta framework & drift"),
    (3, "onboarding", "Onboarding & contributors"),
]


def inventory(root):
    observations = {}

    def text(path):
        file = root / path
        return file.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if file.is_file() else ""

    def candidates(patterns):
        return sorted({str(p.relative_to(root)) for pattern in patterns
                       for p in root.glob(pattern) if p.is_file() and p.stat().st_size
                       and p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip() not in {"", "{}", "[]", "module.exports = {};"}})

    def put(id_, evidence, detail, paths=()):
        observations[id_] = {"evidence": evidence, "detail": detail, "paths": list(paths)}

    def detect(id_, patterns, next_test):
        paths = candidates(patterns)
        put(id_, "CONFIGURED" if paths else "MISSING",
            ("Candidate files found. " if paths else "No supported nonempty files detected. ")
            + next_test, paths)

    steering = candidates(["AGENTS.md", "CLAUDE.md"])
    if steering:
        violations = [p for p in steering if len(text(p).splitlines()) > 200]
        put("steering", "CONFIGURED",
            "Advisory: 200-line suggested budget exceeded; assess local policy and loading cost: " + ", ".join(violations) if violations else
            "Within suggested line budget; content quality and session loading untested.", steering)
    else:
        put("steering", "MISSING", "No supported steering file detected.")

    package = None
    if (root / "package.json").is_file():
        try:
            package = json.loads(text("package.json"))
            if not isinstance(package, dict):
                raise ValueError("expected an object")
        except (ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError):
            package = None
            put("gates", "FAILED", "Invalid package.json; cannot inspect scripts.", ["package.json"])
    gate_paths = candidates(["scripts/validate.sh"])
    scripts = package.get("scripts", {}) if package is not None else {}
    if isinstance(scripts, dict) and isinstance(scripts.get("validate"), str) and scripts["validate"].strip():
        gate_paths.append("package.json")
        if scripts["validate"].strip() in {"true", ":", "exit 0"}:
            put("gates", "FAILED", "validate is a known no-op, not validation.", ["package.json"])
    if re.search(r"^validate\s*:", text("Makefile"), re.M):
        gate_paths.append("Makefile")
    if "gates" not in observations:
        recognized = any((root / p).is_file() for p in ["package.json", "pyproject.toml", "go.mod", "Cargo.toml", "Makefile"])
        put("gates", "CONFIGURED" if gate_paths else "MISSING" if recognized else "UNKNOWN",
            "Entrypoint detected; gates were NOT run. Test a deliberate violation and compare CI."
            if gate_paths else "No supported validate entrypoint detected; inspect stack before deciding applicability.", gate_paths)

    detect("commits", ["commitlint.config.*", ".commitlintrc*", "lefthook.yml", ".husky/commit-msg"],
           "Confirm convention enforcement by rejecting an invalid commit; a config alone is insufficient.")
    settings = {}
    settings_present = (root / ".claude/settings.json").is_file()
    if settings_present:
        try:
            settings = json.loads(text(".claude/settings.json"))
            if not isinstance(settings, dict):
                raise ValueError("expected an object")
        except (ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError):
            settings = {}
            put("hooks", "FAILED", "Invalid .claude/settings.json.", [".claude/settings.json"])
    if "hooks" not in observations:
        hooks = settings.get("hooks")
        has_command = isinstance(hooks, dict) and any(
            isinstance(event, list) and any(
                isinstance(group, dict) and isinstance(group.get("hooks"), list) and any(
                    isinstance(h, dict) and isinstance(h.get("command"), str) and h["command"].strip()
                    for h in group["hooks"])
                for group in event)
            for event in hooks.values())
        put("hooks", "CONFIGURED" if has_command else "MISSING",
            "Hook command detected; fire its event with a safe violation to prove enforcement."
            if has_command else "No hook command detected in supported settings; inspect other harnesses separately.",
            [".claude/settings.json"] if settings_present else [])
    detect("permissions", ["docs/PERMISSIONS.md", ".claude/settings.json", ".claude/managed-settings.json"],
           "Inspect ask/deny semantics, independent ownership, scoped identity, host secrets and egress; authorized APIs/probes may supply evidence.")
    detect("ci", [".github/workflows/*.yml", ".github/workflows/*.yaml", ".gitlab-ci.yml"],
           "Confirm the same validate command runs and an intentionally failing PR cannot merge.")
    put("trunk", "UNKNOWN", "Inspect branch age/size in git and hosting APIs; confirm team workflow and feature-flag policy.")
    detect("skills", [".claude/skills/*/SKILL.md", ".agents/skills/*/SKILL.md", ".opencode/skills/*/SKILL.md"],
           "Exercise repo conventions; empty directories are not skills and number of skills is not quality.")
    put("cleancode", "UNKNOWN", "Review a real diff: explanation quality needs judgment; run ticket-reference checks separately.")
    detect("testint", ["scripts/no-test-weakening.sh", ".github/workflows/*test*.*", "stryker.conf*", ".mutmut*"],
           "Diff heuristics are not semantic integrity; try a weakened assertion and use mutation tests or review.")
    detect("arch", [".dependency-cruiser.*", ".importlinter", "import-linter.toml", "*ArchUnit*", ".golangci.y*ml"],
           "Prove a forbidden dependency fails validate; a linter file may contain no boundary rules.")
    detect("devcontainer", [".devcontainer/devcontainer.json", ".devcontainer.json"],
           "Rebuild cleanly and probe denied egress/secret access safely; a container alone proves no security boundary.")
    detect("adrs", ["docs/decisions/INDEX.md", "docs/adr/*.md", "docs/decisions/*[0-9]*.md"],
           "Check index/records and governed paths, then test task-scoped retrieval and supersession.")
    detect("sessions", ["docs/handoff-template.md", "docs/HANDOFF.md"],
           "Have a fresh session resume correctly, including reasons and do-not-redo decisions.")
    put("graph", "UNKNOWN", "Probe configured indexer, freshness and representative definition/caller queries; measure effort and correctness.")
    docs_mentions = [p for p in steering if re.search(r"context7|llms\.txt|installed version|lockfile", text(p), re.I)]
    put("vdocs", "CONFIGURED" if docs_mentions else "UNKNOWN",
        "Retrieval guidance detected; verify a query matches the installed version." if docs_mentions else
        "Inspect docs retrieval tools and test installed-version matching; no supported guidance detected.", docs_mentions)
    put("memory", "UNKNOWN", "Probe authorized store for dated/sourced recall, expiry and separation from instructions; avoid sensitive contents.")
    detect("supply", [".github/workflows/dependency-review.y*ml", ".mcp.json"],
           "Dependency review is only one control; verify dependency approval, untrusted-input handling and egress separately.")
    put("where", "UNKNOWN", "Sample facts and trace their authoritative home, scope and retrieval cost; detect conflicting copies.")
    detect("agents", [".claude/agents/*.md", ".opencode/agents/*.md", ".opencode/agent/*.md"],
           "Run a bounded delegation; prove tool scope, ownership and summary-only handback, not merely agent count.")
    detect("bots", [".github/labeler.yml", ".github/workflows/label-impact.y*ml", ".github/CODEOWNERS"],
           "Test an impactful PR's required reviews and autonomy; labels alone enforce neither.")
    detect("tracker", [".github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*.md", ".github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*.yml", ".github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*.yaml"],
           "Verify a real work item is accessible and agent-ready; another shared, versioned specification home can be equivalent.")
    detect("deploy", [".github/workflows/deploy.y*ml"],
           "Query production reviewer/bypass rules and rehearse change rollback plus agent credential revocation; owner authorizes tests.")
    put("metrics", "UNKNOWN", "Inspect attributed follow-up fix-rate cohorts, observation window, review effort and delivery outcomes; validate data definitions.")
    detect("meta", [".github/workflows/drift.y*ml", "scripts/steering-drift.sh"],
           "A script is not a schedule: inject harmless drift and confirm detection, assignment and resolution.")
    detect("onboarding", ["ONBOARDING.md", "CONTRIBUTORS.md", "CONTRIBUTING.md"],
           "Check onboarding and contribution coverage; have a newcomer complete the first task without undocumented help.")

    return [{"tier": tier, "id": id_, "pillar": name, "applicability": "UNASSESSED", **observations[id_]}
            for tier, id_, name in PILLARS]


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="emit structured inventory")
    parser.add_argument("--strict", action="store_true", help="exit 1 unless every pillar is VERIFIED (static inventory cannot certify this)")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = Path(os.environ.get("TARGET_REPO", ".")).resolve()
    if not root.is_dir():
        parser.error(f"target directory does not exist: {root}")
    try:
        rows = inventory(root)
    except (OSError, UnicodeError) as error:
        print(f"ERROR: could not inspect target: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    counts = dict(Counter(r["evidence"] for r in rows))
    note = "Static inventory only. CONFIGURED is not VERIFIED; MISSING is not NOT_APPLICABLE. Assess fit, authority and behavioral evidence before adoption."
    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps({"schema_version": 2, "pillar_count": len(rows), "counts": counts, "note": note, "pillars": rows}, indent=2))
    else:
        print(f"{'TIER':<6} {'PILLAR':<34} {'EVIDENCE':<12} DETAIL")
        for row in rows:
            print(f"{row['tier']:<6} {row['pillar']:<34} {row['evidence']:<12} {row['detail']}")
        print("\n" + " ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in sorted(counts.items())))
        print(note)
    return int(counts.get("FAILED", 0) > 0 or args.strict and any(r["evidence"] != "VERIFIED" for r in rows))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Adversarial regression fixtures; no hosting access or target-code execution."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest


SOURCE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
TEMPLATE = "assets/templates/tier-0/AGENTS.md"


class BaselineTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="lean-test-", dir=os.environ.get("BASELINE_TEST_TMPDIR"))
        self.addCleanup(self.temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temporary.name)
        self.repo = self.root / "target"
        self.repo.mkdir()

    def file(self, path, content):
        target = self.repo / path
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_text(content)
        return target

    def run_script(self, name, *args, skill=None):
        return subprocess.run(["bash", str((skill or SOURCE) / "scripts" / name), *args],
                              cwd=self.repo, env={**os.environ, "TARGET_REPO": str(self.repo)},
                              text=True, capture_output=True)

    def score(self):
        result = self.run_script("scorecard.sh", "--json")
        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 2, result.stderr)
        data = json.loads(result.stdout)
        return result, {row["id"]: row for row in data["pillars"]}, data

    def pin_skill(self):
        skill = self.root / "skill"
        shutil.copytree(SOURCE, skill, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "version-history"))
        result = self.run_script("generate-version-manifest.sh", skill=skill)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        return skill

    def adopt(self, skill, content="Adapted steering for this project\n"):
        self.file("AGENTS.md", content)
        result = self.run_script("adopt.sh", TEMPLATE, "AGENTS.md", skill=skill)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)

    def upstream_change(self, skill):
        source = skill / TEMPLATE
        source.write_text(source.read_text() + "\nUpstream change\n")
        data = json.loads((skill / "VERSION.json").read_text())
        data["files"][TEMPLATE] = "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        (skill / "VERSION.json").write_text(json.dumps(data))

    def test_all_26_pillars_once_and_unassessed(self):
        result, rows, data = self.score()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(data["pillar_count"], 26)
        self.assertEqual(len(rows), 26)
        self.assertIn("where", rows)
        self.assertTrue(all(row["applicability"] == "UNASSESSED" for row in rows.values()))
        self.assertTrue(all(row["evidence"] != "VERIFIED" for row in rows.values()))

    def test_empty_directories_and_configs_do_not_pass(self):
        for path in [".github/workflows", ".claude/skills", ".claude/agents", ".github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE"]:
            (self.repo / path).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.file(".claude/settings.json", "{}")
        self.file(".devcontainer.json", "{}")
        self.file(".dependency-cruiser.js", "module.exports = {};")
        _, rows, _ = self.score()
        for id_ in ["ci", "skills", "agents", "tracker", "hooks", "devcontainer", "arch"]:
            self.assertEqual(rows[id_]["evidence"], "MISSING", id_)

    def test_noop_validate_is_failed(self):
        self.file("package.json", '{"scripts":{"validate":"true"}}')
        result, rows, _ = self.score()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertEqual(rows["gates"]["evidence"], "FAILED")

    def test_candidates_are_not_verified_and_never_execute(self):
        self.file("package.json", '{"scripts":{"validate":"touch executed"}}')
        self.file(".github/workflows/ci.yml", "name: CI\n")
        self.file(".claude/agents/api.md", "API domain agent\n")
        _, rows, _ = self.score()
        for id_ in ["gates", "ci", "agents"]:
            self.assertEqual(rows[id_]["evidence"], "CONFIGURED", id_)
        self.assertFalse((self.repo / "executed").exists())

    def test_invalid_package_json_fails_without_crash(self):
        for bad in ["{", "[]"]:
            self.file("package.json", bad)
            result, rows, _ = self.score()
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
            self.assertEqual(rows["gates"]["evidence"], "FAILED")

    def test_invalid_hook_settings_fails_without_crash(self):
        self.file(".claude/settings.json", "[]")
        result, rows, _ = self.score()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertEqual(rows["hooks"]["evidence"], "FAILED")

    def test_actual_hook_command_is_only_configured(self):
        self.file(".claude/settings.json", json.dumps({"hooks": {"PreToolUse": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "touch executed"}]}]}}))
        _, rows, _ = self.score()
        self.assertEqual(rows["hooks"]["evidence"], "CONFIGURED")
        self.assertFalse((self.repo / "executed").exists())

    def test_strict_mode_does_not_certify_static_inventory(self):
        result = self.run_script("scorecard.sh", "--strict")
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)

    def test_suggested_steering_budget_is_advisory(self):
        self.file("AGENTS.md", "Useful local guidance\n" * 201)
        result, rows, _ = self.score()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(rows["steering"]["evidence"], "CONFIGURED")
        self.assertIn("Advisory", rows["steering"]["detail"])

    def test_invalid_target_fails_instead_of_scoring_wrong_repo(self):
        result = subprocess.run(["bash", str(SOURCE / "scripts/scorecard.sh")],
                                env={**os.environ, "TARGET_REPO": str(self.root / "absent")}, text=True, capture_output=True)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)

    def test_adapted_file_is_pass_immediately_after_adoption(self):
        skill = self.pin_skill()
        self.adopt(skill)
        result = self.run_script("check-pinned-versions.sh", str(self.repo), skill=skill)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn("PASS", result.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn("EDITED", result.stdout)
        manifest = json.loads((self.repo / ".lean-agentic-baseline/manifest.json").read_text())
        entry = manifest["adopted"][0]
        self.assertNotEqual(entry["adopted_sha256"], entry["template_sha256"])

    def test_extensionless_templates_and_guidance_are_preserved(self):
        skill = self.pin_skill()
        version = json.loads((skill / "VERSION.json").read_text())
        template = "assets/templates/tier-3/CODEOWNERS"
        for path in [template, "SKILL.md", "README.md", "references/assessment.md"]:
            self.assertIn(path, version["files"])
        self.file(".github/CODEOWNERS", "* @example-org/maintainers\n")
        result = self.run_script("adopt.sh", template, ".github/CODEOWNERS", skill=skill)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)

    def test_local_edit_reported_independently(self):
        skill = self.pin_skill()
        self.adopt(skill)
        self.file("AGENTS.md", "Later local change\n")
        result = self.run_script("check-pinned-versions.sh", str(self.repo), skill=skill)
        self.assertIn("EDITED", result.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn("DRIFT", result.stdout)

    def test_upstream_and_local_changes_are_both_visible(self):
        skill = self.pin_skill()
        self.adopt(skill)
        self.upstream_change(skill)
        result = self.run_script("check-pinned-versions.sh", str(self.repo), skill=skill)
        self.assertIn("DRIFT", result.stdout)
        self.file("AGENTS.md", "Later local change\n")
        result = self.run_script("check-pinned-versions.sh", str(self.repo), skill=skill)
        self.assertIn("DRIFT_EDITED", result.stdout)

    def test_missing_target_and_template_fail(self):
        skill = self.pin_skill()
        self.adopt(skill)
        (skill / TEMPLATE).unlink()
        result = self.run_script("check-pinned-versions.sh", str(self.repo), skill=skill)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertIn("TEMPLATE_GONE", result.stdout)
        (self.repo / "AGENTS.md").unlink()
        result = self.run_script("check-pinned-versions.sh", str(self.repo), skill=skill)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertIn("GONE", result.stdout)

    def test_legacy_adaptation_is_unknown_not_falsely_edited(self):
        skill = self.pin_skill()
        self.adopt(skill)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Track upstream templates separately from the adapted files actually adopted."""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile


SKILL = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
GUIDE_VERSION = "v3.2"
SKILL_REVISION = "2026-10-07.2"
REVIEWED_GUIDE_REVISION = "23d61dbe16dd38d38169a0f0b472f5bbc0da0235"


def sha(path):
    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def load(path):
    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise ValueError(f"{path.name}: expected an object")
    return data


def contained(root, relative):
    path = Path(relative)
    if path.is_absolute() or ".." in path.parts:
        raise ValueError("paths must be relative, without '..'")
    result = (root / path).resolve()
    if not result.is_relative_to(root.resolve()):
        raise ValueError("path escapes its repository through a symlink")
    return result


def write_atomic(path, data):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w", encoding="utf-8", dir=path.parent, delete=False) as file:
        temporary = Path(file.name)
        json.dump(data, file, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
        file.write("\n")
    try:
        os.replace(temporary, path)
    finally:
        temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)


def version():
    data = load(SKILL / "VERSION.json")
    if not isinstance(data.get("files"), dict) or not isinstance(data.get("guide_version"), str):
        raise ValueError("invalid VERSION.json; regenerate it")
    return data


def manifest_entries(data):
    entries = data.get("adopted")
    if not isinstance(entries, list) or any(
        not isinstance(e, dict) or not all(isinstance(e.get(k), str) and e[k]
                                         for k in ("template", "target_path", "template_sha256", "guide_version"))
        or ("adopted_sha256" in e and not isinstance(e["adopted_sha256"], str))
        for e in entries):
        raise ValueError("invalid adoption manifest; expected complete adopted entries")
    if len({e["target_path"] for e in entries}) != len(entries):
        raise ValueError("invalid adoption manifest: duplicate target paths")
    return entries


def adopt(template, target):
    root = Path(os.environ.get("TARGET_REPO", ".")).resolve()
    if not root.is_dir():
        raise ValueError("target repository directory does not exist")
    source = contained(SKILL, template)
    destination = contained(root, target)
    if not destination.is_file():
        raise ValueError("target file must exist before adoption is recorded")
    data = version()
    upstream_hash = data["files"].get(template)
    if not upstream_hash or not source.is_file():
        raise ValueError("template not tracked in VERSION.json")
    if sha(source) != upstream_hash:
        raise ValueError("template differs from VERSION.json; regenerate the manifest before adoption")
    manifest = contained(root, ".lean-agentic-baseline/manifest.json")
    record = load(manifest) if manifest.exists() else {"schema_version": 2, "adopted": []}
    entries = manifest_entries(record)
    entry = {"template": template, "template_sha256": upstream_hash,
             "target_path": target, "adopted_sha256": sha(destination),
             "guide_version": data["guide_version"], "skill_revision": data.get("skill_revision"),
             "adopted_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
    record.update(schema_version=2, adopted=[e for e in entries if e["target_path"] != target] + [entry])
    write_atomic(manifest, record)
    print(f"PASS: recorded upstream AND adapted file hashes for {target}")
    return 0


def check(root):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    manifest = contained(root, ".lean-agentic-baseline/manifest.json")
    if not manifest.is_file():
        print("SKIP: no adoption manifest; nothing recorded")
        return 2
    entries = manifest_entries(load(manifest))
    if not entries:
        print("SKIP: adoption manifest has no entries")
        return 2
    data = version()
    failed = False
    print(f"{'TARGET':<40} {'STATUS':<23} DETAIL")
    for entry in entries:
        source = contained(SKILL, entry["template"])
        target = contained(root, entry["target_path"])
        current = data["files"].get(entry["template"])
        if not target.is_file():
            state, detail, failed = "GONE", "adopted target is missing", True
        elif not current or not source.is_file():
            state, detail, failed = "TEMPLATE_GONE", "upstream template no longer available; review replacement", True
        elif sha(source) != current:
            state, detail, failed = "MANIFEST_STALE", "live template differs from VERSION.json; regenerate it", True
        else:
            upstream_changed = current != entry["template_sha256"]
            baseline = entry.get("adopted_sha256")
            if baseline is None:
                # Legacy manifests did not record adaptations; do not invent a baseline.
                baseline = entry["template_sha256"] if sha(target) == entry["template_sha256"] else None
            if baseline is None:
                state = "DRIFT_BASELINE_UNKNOWN" if upstream_changed else "BASELINE_UNKNOWN"
                detail = "legacy manifest lacks adapted-file hash; review and re-adopt; upstream changed" if upstream_changed else "legacy manifest lacks adapted-file hash; review and re-adopt"
            else:
                edited = sha(target) != baseline
                state = "DRIFT_EDITED" if upstream_changed and edited else "DRIFT" if upstream_changed else "EDITED" if edited else "PASS"
                detail = "upstream changed; local file edited since adoption" if state == "DRIFT_EDITED" else "upstream changed; preserve adaptation while reviewing" if upstream_changed else "local file edited since adoption" if edited else "adapted file unchanged; upstream template unchanged"
        print(f"{entry['target_path']:<40} {state:<23} {detail}")
    print("No files overwritten. Hashes detect change, not semantic correctness; review both upstream and local changes.")
    return int(failed)


def generate():
    paths = sorted(set(
        [p for p in (SKILL / "assets/templates").rglob("*") if p.is_file()]
        + [p for p in (SKILL / "scripts").rglob("*") if p.is_file() and p.suffix in {".sh", ".py"}]
        + [SKILL / "SKILL.md", SKILL / "README.md"]
        + list((SKILL / "references").glob("*.md"))))
    files = {str(p.relative_to(SKILL)): sha(p) for p in paths}
    key = f"{GUIDE_VERSION}-{SKILL_REVISION}"
    snapshot = contained(SKILL, f"references/version-history/{key}.contents.json")
    contents = {str(p.relative_to(SKILL)): p.read_text(encoding="utf-8") for p in paths}
    if snapshot.exists() and load(snapshot) != contents:
        raise ValueError("content snapshot already exists; bump SKILL_REVISION rather than overwriting history")
    out = SKILL / "VERSION.json"
    if out.exists():
        old = version()
        if old["files"] != files or old.get("skill_revision") != SKILL_REVISION or old["guide_version"] != GUIDE_VERSION:
            key = old["guide_version"] + ("-" + old["skill_revision"] if old.get("skill_revision") else "")
            archive = contained(SKILL, f"references/version-history/{key}.json")
            if archive.exists() and load(archive) != old:
                raise ValueError("history key already exists with different content; bump SKILL_REVISION")
            if not archive.exists():
                write_atomic(archive, old)
    data = {"guide_title": "Lean Agentic Baseline", "guide_version": GUIDE_VERSION,
            "guide_assessed_date": "2026-09-20", "source_file": "lean-agentic-baseline.html",
            "skill_revision": SKILL_REVISION,
            "reviewed_guide": {"repository": "https://github.com/emb715/lean-agile-agentic",
                               "revision": REVIEWED_GUIDE_REVISION, "assessed_date": "2026-10-07",
                               "scope": "26-pillar inventory and goal-based assessment; templates retain their v3.2 origin"},
            "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "files": files}
    write_atomic(out, data)
    # Content snapshots permit actual before/after diffs; legacy archives remain hash-only.
    if not snapshot.exists():
        write_atomic(snapshot, contents)
    print(f"PASS: generated {len(files)} hashes; guide {GUIDE_VERSION}, skill {SKILL_REVISION}; retained content snapshot")
    return 0


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    adoption = commands.add_parser("adopt")
    adoption.add_argument("template")
    adoption.add_argument("target")
    checking = commands.add_parser("check")
    checking.add_argument("root", nargs="?", default=os.environ.get("TARGET_REPO", "."))
    commands.add_parser("generate")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        return adopt(args.template, args.target) if args.command == "adopt" else check(args.root) if args.command == "check" else generate()
    except (OSError, ValueError, UnicodeError) as error:
        print(f"FAIL: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
